parameters.name: cidr
parameters.description: The range of available subnets in the VPC.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in VPC. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeouts
parameters.description: The timeouts for each operations. Default: {}

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
- name: Create a vpc
  community.general.hwc_network_vpc:
    identity_endpoint: "{{ identity_endpoint }}"
    user: "{{ user }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"
    domain: "{{ domain }}"
    project: "{{ project }}"
    region: "{{ region }}"
    name: "vpc_1"
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/24"
    state: present

return_values.name: cidr
return_values.description: The range of available subnets in the VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: enable_shared_snat
return_values.description: Show whether the shared SNAT is enabled. Returned: success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: The ID of VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of VPC. Returned: success

return_values.name: destination
return_values.description: The destination network segment of a route. Returned: success

return_values.name: next_hop
return_values.description: The next hop of a route. If the route type is peering, it provides VPC peering connection ID. Returned: success

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The status of VPC. Returned: success
